review.eventDescription: One Indeed employee review: rating, 5 sub-ratings, pros, cons, job title, employer reply (row keys review_id, company, rating, work_life_balance, compensation_benefits, job_security_advancement, management, culture_values, title, text, pros, cons, job_title, location, review_date, employer_reply, url): $3 per 1,000 reviews, at most companies x maxReviewsPerCompany x $0.003 per run (default 100 = $0.30 per company). Not charged: reviews your filters remove, reviews an earlier onlyNewReviews run already delivered, duplicates, the company row (ratings, industry, size, CEO), status rows, companies without reviews, unknown company names, failed pages. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. A maximum cost per run set when starting the run is honoured too.
